description.value: Freshslice Pizza is a BC-based pizza chain offering by-the-slice and whole-pie options for takeout and delivery. The East Hastings Street location sits in a dense urban corridor in East Vancouver. It is a no-frills fast-food stop with a broad menu of customizable pizzas.
